name: Senior Year
source:
Senior Year is a fully voiced, original English language visual novel. It follows a protagonist (you), as you go through your last year of college. It is a story of love, relationships, and fun. 

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=1598]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
《Senior Year》是一部全程配音的原创英语视觉小说。玩家将扮演主人公，度过大学最后一年。这是一个关于爱情、人际关系和欢乐的故事。

[摘自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=1598]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
